<style id="w2LabelStyle">  /* ═══ THE LABEL — fixed 100 × 150 mm ═══ */
  .label{
    width:100mm;height:150mm;min-width:100mm;max-width:100mm;flex:0 0 auto;
    padding:3mm;background:#fff;color:#000;
    font-family:'Sarabun','Noto Sans Thai',sans-serif;
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;
  }
  .sheet{flex:0 0 auto}
  .sheet .label{box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--line),0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.55)}
  .lab-in{flex:1;border:1px solid #000;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}

  /* zone 1 — sender, 11mm */
  .sender-bar{height:11mm;flex:0 0 11mm;border-bottom:1px solid #000;padding:0 4mm;display:flex;align-items:center;overflow:hidden}
  .s-tag{font-size:6pt;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1.2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#777;flex-shrink:0;margin-right:2.5mm}
  .s-name{font-size:8.5pt;font-weight:700;flex:1;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  .s-tel{font-size:8.5pt;color:#333;flex-shrink:0;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;margin-left:2.5mm}

  /* zone 2 — recipient, 50mm — trimmed to only what one line of each field
     actually needs; fitBox still shrinks/wraps the rare long entry */
  .recv{height:50mm;flex:0 0 50mm;padding:3mm 4mm 0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;box-sizing:border-box}
  .r-tag{font-size:6pt;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1.2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#999;height:3.5mm;flex:0 0 3.5mm;line-height:1}
  .r-name{overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-size:21pt;font-weight:800;line-height:1.2;height:13mm;flex:0 0 13mm;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:flex-start}
  .r-tel{font-size:13pt;font-weight:700;height:7mm;flex:0 0 7mm;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;display:flex;align-items:center}
  .r-addr{overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-size:10.5pt;line-height:1.5;color:#111;height:13mm;flex:0 0 13mm;overflow:hidden;border-top:0.4mm solid #e2e2e2;padding-top:1.8mm;box-sizing:border-box}
  /* note box sized so a normal one-line note never has to hit min-size —
     rn-tag uses line-height:1 (body's 1.5 default was silently eating most
     of the box before) so the text line actually gets its share of height */
  .r-note{height:9.5mm;flex:0 0 9.5mm;overflow:hidden;border-top:0.35mm dashed #ccc;padding:1.2mm 0 1.3mm;margin-top:1.5mm;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-sizing:border-box}
  .r-note .rn-tag{font-size:6pt;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1.2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#999;line-height:1;flex:0 0 auto;margin-bottom:0.6mm}
  .r-note .rn-txt{overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-size:8pt;line-height:1.25;color:#333;flex:1;overflow:hidden}

  /* zone 3 — postal, standalone, 15mm — same 11×13mm digit boxes, just less
     dead margin around them */
  .postal{height:15mm;flex:0 0 15mm;padding:0 4mm;display:flex;align-items:center;border-top:1px solid #000;background:#fafafa;box-sizing:border-box}
  .postal-sym{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:16pt;font-weight:700;line-height:1;margin-right:3mm}
  .pd{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:17pt;font-weight:700;width:11mm;height:13mm;border:1.6px solid #000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;line-height:1;background:#fff;margin-right:1.6mm;box-sizing:border-box}
  .pd:last-child{margin-right:0}

  /* zone 4 — contents (item list), flexes to whatever's left above the footer */
  .dn{flex:1;border-top:1px solid #000;padding:2.5mm 4mm 3mm;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;min-height:0;box-sizing:border-box}
  .dn-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;height:4mm;flex:0 0 4mm}
  .dn-tag{font-size:6pt;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1.2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#999}
  .dn-qty{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:6.5pt;font-weight:700;color:#666}
  /* two real columns (not CSS columns) so overflow is measurable */
  .dn-items{flex:1;font-size:9.5pt;line-height:1.5;color:#111;overflow:hidden;padding-top:1mm;display:flex;align-items:flex-start}
  .dn-col{flex:1 1 0;min-width:0;padding-right:3mm;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
  .dn-col:last-child{padding-right:0}
  .dn-more{font-weight:700;color:#555}

  /* zone 5 — footer, caution sticker — true edge-to-edge bleed, height follows the art's aspect ratio */
  .footer{
    flex:0 0 auto;border-top:1px solid #000;
    padding:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    overflow:hidden;background:#fff;
  }
  .footer img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}

</style>
